hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mise trust -q && mise install --locked node pnpm hk >&2 && mise x -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline >&2 && { [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo 'eval "$(mise env -s bash -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")"' >>"$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; }
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f="$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path)" && case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) mise x -- hk fix -q -n --no-stage "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && HK_PROFILE=slow mise x -- hk agent stop-hook --target claude-code --timeout 170
